title: Halifax Walking Food Tour
includes: Guided food tour with local tastings and water included.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Let’s experience the best food in Halifax together! Join us before lunch—you’ll be full by the end of the tour. Along the way, your guide will share stories about the city while you enjoy a variety of local specialties.

If you're staying longer in Halifax, we also offer a private Peggy’s Cove tour for a scenic coastal experience.
